result.question: Quantos municípios têm dados socioeconômicos registrados?
result.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT codigo_6d) AS total_municipios FROM socioeconomico;
result.generated_sql: SELECT mu."codigo_6d", COUNT(DISTINCT s."codigo_6d") AS total_municipios FROM municipios mu JOIN socioeconomico s ON s."codigo_6d" = mu."codigo_6d" GROUP BY mu."codigo_6d", mu."codigo_ibge", mu."nome", mu."latitude", mu."longitude", mu."estado";
